Hi Emma — welcome and thanks for the note. Copying Ben from our AP team to confirm the operational side. High-level guidance below, and Ben will add details / templates.

- Preferred path: Redwood Supplier Portal (single place for PO matching, faster payments).
- Email fallback: invoices@redwood.com only for exceptions; subject must include "PO#<your PO number> | ClearWave" to auto-route.
- Required fields: Redwood PO number, line-level description, unit price, invoice total, invoice date, supplier tax ID.
- File types: PDF preferred; CSV accepted for bulk/automated submissions (use our template).

Ben — could you attach the onboarding form and the CSV template and confirm typical turnaround SLA once a vendor is activated? Also, are there any maximum attachment size or filename constraints?

Best,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Emma Jones <emma.jones@clearwave.com>
Date: 2026-01-11T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — invoice submission channel?

Hi Emma — nice to meet you over email. A few operational notes and attached files.

What we prefer: portal-first. The portal supports PO stamping and automatic 2-way match where possible. For emailed invoices we have an ingestion pipeline but it is treated as an exception path and may require manual review, which adds time.

Key requirements for email fallback (invoices@redwood.com):
- Subject format: "PO#<PO_NUMBER> | ClearWave | INVOICE" (example: PO#123456 | ClearWave | INVOICE)
- Attachments: maximum 1 PDF per invoice (if multiple invoices, send separate emails).
- If sending CSV (automated batch): use our template (attached: redwood_invoice_template.csv) and include a header row exactly as in the template.
- File naming: <SupplierName>_<InvoiceNumber>_<YYYYMMDD>.<ext>

SLA & activation: once the onboarding form is submitted and vendor is activated in our AP system, payments are on our standard Net 30 terms; portal uploads will typically process within 2 business days, emailed exceptions can take 5–7 business days.

Attachments (stubs): redwood_invoice_template.csv (CSV template for ERP imports), clearwave_onboarding_form.pdf (vendor onboarding form).

Ben Carter
AP Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Hi Emma — answers inline below and a next-step checklist.

1) PO formatting: we accept leading zeros; our ingestion normalizes numeric fields, but please include the full PO string as shown on the PO document to avoid mismatch.
2) W-9: yes, please attach a W-9 for US entities. We mark tax docs in the vendor profile and it speeds activation.
3) Currency: one currency per upload. For mixed-currency invoices, send separate files or use the portal which supports line-level currency more reliably.

Next steps for fastest onboarding:
- Attach the completed onboarding form (you already sent — thanks).
- Upload to the Redwood Supplier Portal: https://portal.redwood.com/suppliers/enroll (invite will be sent once we create the vendor record).
- If you must email invoices in the short term, use invoices@redwood.com with the subject format Ben specified.
- I'll create the vendor record today and loop Finance for activation; expect an activation email within 48 hours once Ben confirms tax docs.

If you'd like, I can schedule a 20-min screen share with Ben to walk the portal upload process. What time zone are you in?

Best,
Sofia
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
